purpose: Design of the doc-link SKILL and custom Agent composition: responsibilities, check SKILL findings, use cases, per-SKILL sequences, the operation flow, and Agent data exchange.
summary: Eight SKILLs and two custom Agents (toc-updater, query-worker) with write permissions and corresponding requirements

Per-SKILL sequence diagrams from embed-dlid through resolve-dlid
Steps for the project management AI to write a reference with a content hash

Instruction for handling check-impact results: judge, fix referrers, record hashes, rerun until empty
Data exchange with custom Agents: identifiers, request, result, error value, script validation, deletion timing
